contract.objective: Fix a bug in SlidingWindowLog.Allow in foundation/dsa/datastructure/limiter/sliding_window_log.go. Before admitting a request, Allow must discard only the logged requests that have expired (older than the window: now - timestamp > windowSize), oldest first, and stop at the first logged request that is still inside the window. Currently, as soon as the oldest request has expired, every logged request is discarded - including ones still inside the window - so the limiter admits more than maxRequest requests per window. Do not change the public API, the struct, or the behavior of any other function.
acceptanceCriteria: After the oldest requests expire, requests still inside the window continue to count toward maxRequest
Once maxRequest requests are inside the window further requests are rejected, and requests are admitted again after the whole window has expired
The existing limiter tests still pass
constraints: no new dependencies or imports beyond those the file already has
do not change exported identifiers or signatures

assessment.rationale: One method in one file with a precisely described failure mode (stale loop variable); behavior is fully specified; reproduced and fixed independently in a scratch copy; no API, dependency or cross-package impact.
